title: All Core Devs - Consensus (ACDC) #179, May 28, 2026
agendaMarkdown:
glamsterdam-devnet-4:

- Target gas limit moved to CL via `prepare_payload` has been merged in both the exec API and consensus specs
- Builder deposit overflow capped at 190M for Glamsterdam testing. Has anyone done more deposit benchmark tests?

([https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/pull/764](https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/pull/764)) vs ([https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/pull/793](https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/pull/793))
